items.headline: CoreWeave launches $3B convertible bond sale plus 35M-share ATM program, stock dips on dilution
items.note: Fresh dilutive capital raise (convertible senior notes plus an at-the-market equity program) to fund GPU buildout comes on top of CoreWeave's already-heavy debt load, underscoring continued reliance on external capital markets rather than internally generated cash.

items.headline: SoftBank CDS hovers near three-year high as OpenAI IPO delay exposes funding gap
items.note: SoftBank's 5Y CDS jumped to ~385bps (highest since 2023) after reports OpenAI's IPO may slip to 2027, leaving SoftBank leaning on an upsized $11.87B loan (closed Sept 14) to keep funding its ~$64.6B OpenAI stake while shares plunged as much as 13% — a concrete refinancing/funding-gap risk in the OpenAI-SoftBank deal web.

items.headline: Oracle-led hyperscaler CDS spreads hit record wides as BofA survey names AI capex top systemic credit risk
items.note: 5Y CDS on a basket of Amazon/Google/Microsoft/Oracle broke above 100bps (highest in Apollo's 8-year series) with Oracle's own CDS near record wides, while 42% of BofA's September fund-manager survey (up from 38% in August) now flags AI capex as the likeliest source of a systemic credit event.
